summary: On paper Buffalo has the edge (Buffalo ranks 9th in EPA per dropback, +0.17). Under center, Josh Allen ranks 10th of 31 in EPA per dropback and Geno Smith ranks 17th; x-factor: Garrett Wilson gets 23% of the Jets' targets and 28% of its air yards, and Buffalo's pass defense ranks 7th. The model favors Buffalo at 68%, mostly on passing matchup (4.5 pts) and rushing matchup (1.7 pts).
